# DecorImport

Flora, furniture, street props, signs, lights, walls, doors and floors imported from other SS14 forks and SS13 codebases. Floors that animate in their source
get a `<TileId>Animated` overlay entity to place on the tile. Each sprite's source and licence are in its RSI `meta.json` or its
folder's `attributions.yml`. `Resources/Maps/_WF/DecorImport/` has one showcase map each for flora, furniture, walls and floors,
`alien.yml` shows the alien planets pass by set, and `city.yml` shows the street props, signs and lights.
